payload.recallText:
I was surprised when I read the letter from Mr. Gregory. He told me that the St. Louis Nationals were interested in drafting me from the Pittston baseball team. I thought, "I didn't think I would be in that line for major league team so soon." I was excited about the opportunity, even though I knew I would really have to work at it. While showing off my pitching arm to Clara and my mom, I accidentally knocked over a water jug and made a big mess. 

I explained that being drafted meant I might have to leave my teammates and join St. Louis. I knew it would be a big challenge, but I said, "I'll make good, Mom!" My mom told me she hoped I would succeed, and I felt ready to prove myself to everyone. I was happy about the chance to earn more money and gain fame by playing in the major leagues. 

I also opened a letter from Mabel Varely and learned that she and her brother Reg were coming to town. I went to the train station during a heavy blizzard to meet them, but the station master told me the train was stuck in Deep Rock Cut because of the snow. I worried because I had friends on that train, so I said "I wonder what I can do to help them?"
